sections.theory:
Reading Comprehension

1. Compare and contrast the behaviour of the people in the past and today, in the light of the poem "Once upon a time".

2. What does the poet want to learn from his son?

3. What do the expressions "laugh with their teeth" and " teeth like a snake's bare fangs" mean?

4. To what does the poet compare the eyes of the modern man in the poem," Once upon a time" and why?

5. Describe the tone of the poem "Once upon a time."

6. Find out the similes and metaphors used by the poet in the first and fourth stanza of the poem.

Writing Suggestions

Write the paraphrase of the following stanzas: stanza 3 (beginning ‘Feel at home!’ ‘Come again’) and stanza 4 (beginning “So I have learned many things, son.”) of the poem. [The two stanzas are quoted in full in the printed book, p. 143.]

Oral Communication

Conduct a group activity in the class, dividing the students into two equal groups. One group will present arguments in favour of the modern time while the other group will give arguments in favour of the past.
sections.urdu:
مطالعہ اور فہم

1. نظم ’’ایک زمانے میں‘‘ کی روشنی میں ماضی اور آج کے لوگوں کے رویے کا موازنہ اور تقابل کریں۔

2. شاعر اپنے بیٹے سے کیا سیکھنا چاہتا ہے؟

3. اظہارات ’’دانتوں سے ہنسنا‘‘ اور ’’سانپ کے ننگے دانتوں جیسے دانت‘‘ کا کیا مطلب ہے؟

4. نظم ’’ایک زمانے میں‘‘ میں شاعر جدید انسان کی آنکھوں کو کس چیز سے تشبیہ دیتا ہے اور کیوں؟

5. نظم ’’ایک زمانے میں‘‘ کے لہجے کو بیان کریں۔

6. نظم کے پہلے اور چوتھے بند میں شاعر کی استعمال کردہ تشبیہات اور استعارات تلاش کریں۔

تحریری تجاویز

درج ذیل بندوں کی نثری وضاحت لکھیں: نظم کا تیسرا بند (جو ’’اپنا گھر سمجھو! پھر آنا‘‘ سے شروع ہوتا ہے) اور چوتھا بند (جو ’’تو بیٹا، میں نے بہت سی چیزیں سیکھی ہیں‘‘ سے شروع ہوتا ہے)۔ [دونوں بند درسی کتاب کے صفحہ 143 پر مکمل درج ہیں۔]

زبانی ابلاغ

جماعت میں ایک گروہی سرگرمی کرائیں اور طلبہ کو دو برابر گروہوں میں تقسیم کریں۔ ایک گروہ جدید دور کے حق میں دلائل پیش کرے گا جبکہ دوسرا گروہ ماضی کے حق میں دلائل دے گا۔

paras.text: B. Future Continuous Tense
paras.urdu: B. مستقبل جاری
paras.pashto: B. راتلونکی روان زمان

paras.text: Definition: The future continuous tense , also called as the future progressive tense, is a tense that shows that an action will take place in future and continue for a certain length of time.
paras.urdu: تعریف: مستقبل جاری، جسے مستقبل استمراری بھی کہتے ہیں، وہ زمانہ ہے جو ظاہر کرتا ہے کہ کوئی کام مستقبل میں ہو گا اور کچھ وقت تک جاری رہے گا۔
paras.pashto: تعریف: راتلونکی روان زمان، چې راتلونکی دوامداره زمان هم بلل کېږي، هغه زمان دی چې ښيي یو کار به په راتلونکي کې ترسره شي او د یوې ټاکلې مودې لپاره به دوام ولري.

paras.text: Form: It is formed using the structure will + be + the present participle (the root verb + ing). For example,
paras.urdu: ساخت: یہ will + be + حال کا اسمِ فاعل (بنیادی فعل + ing) کی ساخت سے بنتا ہے۔ مثلاً،

sections.theory:
Vocabulary and Grammar

A. Read the sentence and guess the meaning of the underlined word from its context.

1. The child was rushed to the hospital after she had an adverse reaction to the medicine. [underlined: adverse]

a. healing   b. harmful   c. soothing   d. helpful

2. The novice teacher was excited about her first teaching job since graduating college. [underlined: novice]

a. Experienced   b. Beginner   c. Knowledgeable   d. Stern

3. The alluring aroma of the cookies drew Sandy toward the kitchen for a taste. [underlined: alluring]

a. Unpleasant   b. Unappetizing   c. Desirable   d. Obnoxious

4. The man should go to jail for his inhumane treatment of his horses. [underlined: inhumane]

a. Loving   b. Caring   c. Proper   d. Cruel

5. The greedy child was snatching candy from the shelf. [underlined: greedy]

a. Happy   b. Pleasant   c. Giving   d. Selfish

6. You should not belittle his effort but thank him for trying. [underlined: belittle]

a. Make important   b. Make unimportant   c. Make inviting   d. Make appealing

7. The sun suddenly vanished from view as the storm clouds rolled across the sky. [underlined: vanished]

a. Appeared   b. Danced   c. Disappeared   d. Floated

8. The soldiers crouched down low behind their vehicle and waited for the enemy to pass. [underlined: crouched]

a. Stooped with bent knees   b. Stood straight and tall   c. Leaned against   d. Ran from

B. Future Continuous Tense

Definition: The future continuous tense , also called as the future progressive tense, is a tense that shows that an action will take place in future and continue for a certain length of time.

Form: It is formed using the structure will + be + the present participle (the root verb + ing). For example,

The plane will be leaving for Saudi Arabia at 3 o'clock.

They will be playing a match in the evening.

Our teacher will be e arriving the class in a short while.
